text: なんだ　もう　きたのか　おまえの　＊は…　まだ　じかんが　かかるぞ

structure.jp: まだ　じかんが　かかるぞ

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のか at the end asks for an explanation of what the speaker sees, often with surprise. もう　きたのか = 'you're here already?'

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to stress what you are telling someone. かかるぞ = 'it'll take time, you know'.
